title: Painlevé Asymptotics of the Focusing Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation with a Finite-Genus Algebro-Geometric Background
summary: We investigate the Cauchy problem for the focusing nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation \begin{equation} iq_t(x,t)+q_{xx}(x,t)+2|q(x,t)|^2q(x,t)=0,\quad x\in\mathbb{R},\quad t\ge0,\nonumber \end{equation} subject to initial data $ q(x,0)$ satisfying the asymptotic boundary conditions \begin{equation}\label{eq:boundary} q(x,0) \sim q^{alg}(x,0) \quad \text{as} \quad x \to \pm\infty,\nonumber \end{equation} where $q^{alg}(x,t)$ denote finite-genus algebro-geometric quasi-periodic solutions of the focusing NLS equation.
